outline.subject: Ferdinand Schörner was a German general and field marshal in the Wehrmacht during World War II.

sections.title: Ferdinand Schörner
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of Schörner's military career, his reputation as a disciplinarian, and his post-war legal convictions.

sections.title: Early life
sections.covers: This section covers Schörner's birth, his entry into the Bavarian Army, his service in World War I, and his activities during the interwar period.

sections.title: World War II
sections.covers: This section details Schörner's commands and actions throughout World War II, his final days as Commander-in-Chief, and his post-war imprisonment and release.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.covers: This section discusses the critical historical assessment of Schörner's brutal disciplinary methods and his unwavering loyalty to Hitler.

sections.title: Awards and decorations
sections.covers: This section lists the military awards and decorations received by Schörner.
